answered.sql: SELECT A.name, S.description FROM Antibiotic A JOIN Prescription P ON A.antibioticID = P.antibioticID JOIN Patient Pa ON P.patientID = Pa.patientID JOIN Serious_Side_Effects S ON S.seriousSideEffectID = A.seriousSideEffects WHERE Pa.firstName = 'Jane' AND Pa.lastName = 'Smith'

candidates.meaning: Show the medicine and its side effects for Mr. Smith
candidates.sql: SELECT A.name, CS.description, SS.description FROM Antibiotic A JOIN Prescription P ON A.antibioticID = P.antibioticID JOIN Patient Pt ON P.patientID = Pt.patientID LEFT JOIN Common_Side_Effects CS ON A.commonSideEffects @> ARRAY[CS.sideEffectID] LEFT JOIN Serious_Side_Effects SS ON A.seriousSideEffects @> ARRAY[SS.seriousSideEffectID] WHERE Pt.firstName || ' ' || Pt.lastName = 'Jane Smith'

candidates.meaning: Show the name of the medicine and its common and serious side effects for Mr. Smith.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.name, A.commonSideEffects, A.seriousSideEffects FROM Antibiotic A JOIN Prescription P ON A.antibioticID = P.antibioticID JOIN Patient Pt ON P.patientID = Pt.patientID WHERE Pt.firstName = 'Jane' AND Pt.lastName = 'Smith'

candidates.meaning: List the medicine and its common side effects for Mr. Smith, ignoring serious side effects.

candidates.meaning: Display the medicine and its side effects (both common and serious) for Mr. Smith, including the date of prescription.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.name, A.commonSideEffects, A.seriousSideEffects, P.datePrescribed FROM Antibiotic A JOIN Prescription P ON A.antibioticID = P.antibioticID JOIN Patient Pt ON P.patientID = Pt.patientID WHERE Pt.firstName = 'Jane' AND Pt.lastName = 'Smith'
